dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: Hmm, no matter how it feels, it still can't compare to real sunlight...

dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: That's right. The people around here would freeze until they faint without this thing.

dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: Technically, I'm on vacation right now... But since I happen to know my way around this kind of work, I took on the maintenance job. Earns me a little extra Mora, too.

dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: Still, speaking personally, while this thing is certainly warm, the feeling it gives off just doesn't compare to actual sunlight.

dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: Hahaha. But in a place like this, sunlight is something you can only hope to be lucky enough to find. If you want to keep warm, this thing is much more reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Shishkina
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Remember to wrap yourself up nice and tight.
